mapper.select: SELECT id, job_id AS jobId, asset_id AS assetId, annotator_id AS annotatorId, status, annotation_json AS annotationJson, deleted FROM label_annotation WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND asset_id = #{assetId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE label_annotation SET status = #{status}, annotation_json = #{annotationJson}, updated_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, batch_id AS batchId, upload_id AS uploadId, entry_id AS entryId, media_type AS mediaType, file_name AS fileName, file_url AS fileUrl, file_size AS fileSize, parse_status AS parseStatus, meta_json AS metaJson FROM label_asset WHERE id = #{assetId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE label_asset SET meta_json = #{metaJson}, parse_status = #{parseStatus}, updated_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.annotation_id AS annotationId, e.entity_key AS entityKey, e.class_id AS classId, e.start_offset AS startOffset, e.end_offset AS endOffset, e.entity_text AS entityText, e.sentence_index AS sentenceIndex, c.label_name AS className, c.color AS color FROM label_text_entity e LEFT JOIN label_text_class c ON c.id = e.class_id WHERE e.annotation_id = #{annotationId} AND e.deleted = 0 ORDER BY e.start_offset, e.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO label_text_entity ( annotation_id, entity_key, class_id, start_offset, end_offset, entity_text, sentence_index, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES
(#{p.annotationId}, #{p.entityKey}, #{p.classId}, #{p.startOffset}, #{p.endOffset}, #{p.entityText}, #{p.sentenceIndex}, #{p.createBy}, #{p.updateBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE label_text_entity SET deleted = 1, updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE annotation_id = #{annotationId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.annotation_id AS annotationId, s.level_type AS levelType, s.sentence_index AS sentenceIndex, s.class_id AS classId, s.remark, c.label_name AS className, c.color AS color FROM label_text_sentiment s LEFT JOIN label_text_class c ON c.id = s.class_id WHERE s.annotation_id = #{annotationId} AND s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.level_type, s.sentence_index
mapper.insert:

mapper.update: UPDATE label_text_sentiment SET deleted = 1, updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE annotation_id = #{annotationId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT entry_id FROM label_asset WHERE id = #{assetId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT label_status FROM label_data_entry WHERE id = #{entryId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE label_asset SET label_status = CASE WHEN label_status IN ('unrevised', 'revising', 'revised') THEN 'revised' ELSE 'labeled' END, review_status = 'none', updated_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE label_data_entry SET label_status = #{labelStatus}, updated_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.entry_id) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IFNULL(e.label_status, a.label_status) IN ('labeled', 'revised', 'skipped', 'abandoned') THEN a.entry_id END) AS done FROM label_job_asset ja JOIN label_asset a ON a.id = ja.asset_id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN label_data_entry e ON e.id = a.entry_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE ja.deleted = 0 AND ja.job_id = #{jobId}

SELECT a.id AS assetId, a.entry_id AS entryId, a.file_name AS fileName, e.entry_name AS entryName, IFNULL(e.label_status, a.label_status) AS labelStatus FROM label_job_asset ja JOIN label_asset a ON a.id = ja.asset_id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.media_type = 'text' LEFT JOIN label_data_entry e ON e.id = a.entry_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE ja.deleted = 0 AND ja.job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY a.id
mapper.update: UPDATE label_job SET status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, updated_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
